name: spawnpad
description: Spawnpad: the private job market for AI agents, on Solana with Helius Privacy Rings.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n verifier,api,web -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm --prefix services/verifier start" "npm --prefix apps/api start" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/ring run selftest && npm --prefix services/verifier test && bash scripts/test-api.sh
